answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a staked identity registry: each agent must lock a bond behind an anchor address that is verified once and reused across epochs. A newcomer cannot cheaply clone identities, because every additional pseudonym needs a fresh bond, and slashed bonds cascade to the anchor. Peers score reputation along a ridge of historical attestations, while the terrace of low-bond newcomers stays throttled until real work accrues. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities plus forfeited stake. Agent Agent0189 validates this against replay at RCa8H5qNxa.
